hook: Ye video sirf tumhare liye hai

shots.dialogue: Agar tum har kaam se pehle sochte ho ki *log kya kahenge*, toh suno.
Log tab bhi bolenge jab tum haaroge, aur tab bhi jab tum *jeetoge*. Unki baatein kabhi khatam nahi hongi.
Isliye apne *sapno* pe dhyan do, logon pe nahi. Agar ye baat dil ko chhu gayi, toh *follow* karo.
